reference_boundary: External agent, plugin, memory and skill sources are method-only references until a separate supply-chain review targets a specific versioned asset. This manifest does not enable external runtimes, hooks, workers, MCP servers or plugin installs.

source_refs.title: claude-mem persistent context plugin

source_refs.title: EveryInc compound engineering plugin
source_refs.notes: Use Plan -> Delegate -> Assess -> Codify workflow vocabulary; do not import the plugin, agents or full skill set.

source_refs.title: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern
source_refs.notes: Use raw sources, maintained wiki, schema and ingest/query/lint loops for archive and memory governance.

must_not: set as default output style
compress destructive-action warnings
compress multi-step instructions where ambiguity increases risk
enable automatic session capture
start background workers
write long-term memory without review
expose local HTTP or vector services by default
import full external skill inventory
replace adk-first routing
spawn external agents without local contract
replace docs/archive with an unreviewed external tool
edit raw source material
treat synthesized wiki pages as source of truth without raw fallback

quality_gates: raw sources are immutable and never edited by the agent
wiki pages cite source material or raw evidence paths
schema defines naming, frontmatter, links and maintenance rules
lint checks stale claims, weak links, orphan pages and unresolved questions
query answers from compiled wiki must record valuable new synthesis back into the wiki only after review
must_not: treat generated wiki summaries as primary evidence
overwrite raw sources
create duplicate entity or concept pages without index lookup
promote external wiki tools without supply-chain review

quality_gates: each completed substantial task explicitly decides whether a reusable convention, component, runbook or manifest update is justified
codify decisions distinguish reusable learning from one-off session noise
guidance promotions require owner review, verification evidence and rollback path
external workflow vocabulary cannot override adk-first routing
must_not: promote every session note into durable guidance
import a full external workflow suite without scope review
replace local verification with external plugin claims

quality_gates: start with compact search results before fetching full observations
fetch timeline context only for selected IDs or scoped queries
batch detail fetches by ID and record why details are needed
long-term memory writes require review and redaction status
memory search must preserve raw evidence fallback
must_not: inject all historical observations into context by default
auto-capture raw tool output into long-term memory
start background workers or local HTTP services by default
treat vector search as authority without source evidence

safety_exceptions: multi-step instruction where compression risks ambiguity
review finding that needs precise evidence
quality_gates: token reduction must not remove command, path, source, risk or verification evidence
high-risk actions temporarily use full clarity
user can return to normal mode explicitly
Chinese technical answers keep terminology precise even when compressed
must_not: make terse style the default for all users
compress legal, security, data-loss or commit-risk warnings
hide uncertainty or missing evidence to save tokens

quality_gates: external executable code requires supply-chain review before optional/profile promotion
plugins with hooks, workers, local ports or MCP tools require explicit runtime trust boundary
memory systems require retention, redaction, owner approval and raw fallback policy
large external skill inventories require sampling and conflict review before import
method-only adoption must not add install commands, package manager steps, plugin manifests or live runtime config
must_not: enable third-party hooks by default
run package-manager install commands during method-only absorption
write to ~/.codex or ~/.claude as part of reference intake
treat popularity, stars or marketplace presence as trust proof
